name: Facet
description: Facet is a self-hosted personal profile platform. Create multiple views of your professional profile for different audiences (recruiters, conferences, clients) and own all of your data. Each view is a curated slice of your full profile: a recruiter sees roles and references, a conference organizer sees talks and bio, a client sees portfolio and rates. You decide what each audience sees and they only see what you've shared. First-time login: visit `/admin`, sign in with the first email from `Admin Emails` (or `admin@example.com` if blank) and the seeded password printed in the container logs. You will be forced to set a new password immediately. Features: - Multiple profile views per person - OAuth login via Google or GitHub (optional) - Optional AI assist via OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama - All data stays on your server - Single Docker container, embedded SQLite database

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Path to app data (SQLite database and configuration). Include this in backups.

paths.name: Uploads Storage
paths.description: Path to uploaded images and files.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to the Facet web UI (Caddy listens on 8080 inside the container).

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Public URL for Facet (e.g. http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8080 or https://facet.example.com). REQUIRED if you want OAuth sign-in or to share profile links externally. Used as the OAuth callback host and the base for share URLs.

variables.name: Admin Emails
variables.description: Comma-separated email allowlist for OAuth login. Leave empty to allow any email.

variables.name: Behind Proxy
variables.description: Set to true if running behind a reverse proxy (NPMplus, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel).

variables.name: OAuth - Google - Client ID
variables.description: Client ID for Sign in with Google. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

variables.name: OAuth - Google - Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret from Google Cloud Console.

variables.name: OAuth - GitHub - Client ID
variables.description: Client ID for Sign in with GitHub. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

variables.name: OAuth - GitHub - Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret from GitHub OAuth Apps.

variables.name: AI - Ollama - URL
variables.description: URL for local Ollama instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:11434).

variables.name: Admin UI Enabled
variables.description: Enable PocketBase admin UI at /_/ for debugging. Leave false in production.
